hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tableau-10 palette and clean control typography show design intent, but 300 randomly-bundled crossing lines overwhelm the circle-pack layout and prevent any readable visual hierarchy in the data layer.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest — scaleSqrt for force-layout node radii, data-driven domains via d3.extent, correct key functions on node and link selections; minor robustness gap: hierarchyLinkSelection lacks a key function, risking element reuse corruption on re-render.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() before new layout transitions causes mid-flight snap on rapid switching; tension slider fires full redrawLinks() (300 paths) on every input tick without RAF coalescing; force-layout drag handlers lack touch/mouse filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Hierarchical color clustering and 65% bundle tension keep the layout readable at the group level, but 300 edges between 200 nodes create a dense crossing tangle in the center that overwhelms the static view — the hover-highlight interaction that would make individual connections traceable cannot be assessed from a screenshot.
